credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of Al Rhode smiling, leaning on his bedroll, holding a metal coffee cup and wearing a dark zippered sweater, his cowboy hat and jacket jacket are on a wool blanket with stripes.  This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Untitled (Al Rhode)
